source.title: Laced moray ( Gymnothorax favagineus ), Ad Dimaniyat Islands, Oman. This moray, also called leopard moray eel, can reach a maximum length of 3 metres (9.8 ft). The laced moray lives on the outer slopes of coral reefs and is widespread throughout the Indo-West Pacific area from eastern coast of Africa, Red Sea included, to Papua New Guinea and from southern Japan to the Great Barrier Reef.
source.creator: Diego Delso
